title.th: พระราชบัญญัติงบประมาณ 2025

completenessNote: 全文，共 4 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。附表 1 篇以 900000+ 序号随同收录。

text.en: 1. This Act is the Supply Act 2025 and comes into operation on 1 April 2025.

2.—(1) A sum of not more than $139,804,307,900 is authorised to be issued from the Consolidated Fund for the period starting 1 April 2025 and ending 31 March 2026.
(2) The sum in subsection (1) is appropriated for the Heads of Expenditure for the public service specified in the Schedule.

3.—(1) A sum of not more than $39,236,834,600 is authorised to be issued from the Development Fund for the period starting 1 April 2025 and ending 31 March 2026.
(2) The sum in subsection (1) is appropriated for development purposes under the Heads of Expenditure specified in the Schedule.
